messages:
ci-bot: [Alert] Perf regression detected in nightly-bench-run (bench-infer). Model: redwood/opt-6b-quant. 95th latency +18% vs baseline. CI run: 1954320000. Logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/1954320000 :warning:

katie: ugh, saw the alert. pinging folks who can triage. @sam @michael any idea if recent kernel change could cause this?

sam: on it. starting with perf traces from the run. grabbing /artifacts/1954320000/prof.tar.gz

sam: quick note — heap of small-batch queueing at step ~1200, looks like batch aggregation had a gap. attaching flamegraph in a sec

michael: I can reproduce a smaller spike locally with the same model and seq_len=1024, running the new UVX kernels. bisecting right now

olivia: linking the patch that rolled yesterday: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/abc123 -- that's the batching optimizer change

deepa: FYI the canary path was flipped yesterday for autoscaler; could be interaction with batching thresholds

katie: ok action plan: (1) sam collect perf artifacts + flamegraph, (2) michael finish local repro and bisect commit range, (3) olivia/infra to revert canary if needed, (4) deepa monitor overnight. any objections?

sam: uploading flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/fg-1954320000.svg

michael: repro complete, root cause narrow to commit abc123 -> abc1f9; looks like batching window metric miscalc. PR incoming to patch. running small bench to validate

olivia: rolling back toggle for autoscaler canary now (took ~30s)

deepa: monitoring dashboard; p95 trending down after rollback. will keep watch and alert if it climbs

katie: thanks. if michael's patch fixes it we'll merge and kick a patch-nightly. @ci-bot please mute this alert group until we have a follow-up run

ci-bot: Alert muted for bench-infer by katie for 2h

sam: I'll leave notes in the PR and post summary in the morning

katie: perfect. wrap up here and ping #incidents if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
